heading: Network restriction
description: Allow selected resource actions only from the local network. Readers and automations are never affected.
loadFailed: The network restriction settings could not be loaded. Reload the page to try again.

detected.inside: Your address {{address}} is inside the allowed network.
detected.outside: Your address {{address}} is outside the allowed network. Check the ranges and the address source before you switch the restriction on, otherwise your own role needs the actions below.
detected.unknown: Your address could not be determined with the current address source, so you count as outside the allowed network.

enabled.label: Restrict actions to the local network
enabled.hint: Off by default. While it is off, the table below changes nothing.

ranges.label: Allowed networks
ranges.hint: IP addresses and CIDR ranges (IPv4 and IPv6), one per line. At least one is required while the restriction is on.

source.label: Where the address comes from
source.hint: Behind a reverse proxy, set TRUST_PROXY (client address) or let the proxy send a header.

client.label: Client address
client.description: The address the server resolves for the request. Honours TRUST_PROXY.

header.label: Request header
header.description: Read the address from a header your reverse proxy sets. If it is missing or not an address, the caller counts as outside.

source.headerWarning: Only safe if Attraccess can be reached only through the proxy that overwrites this header. Otherwise clients can forge it and appear to be local.

roles.label: Allowed from outside, per role
roles.hint: Members of a role may do the checked actions from outside the allowed network. A user may do an action if any of their roles allows it. Admins are not exempt.
roles.ariaLabel: Actions each role may do from outside the allowed network
